tests.description: Reference: WRF 4.8 em_scm_xy single-column run (the scm_ref namelist, use_theta_m = 1, hybrid_opt = 0; GNU gfortran 13.3 REAL*4 build; data/eqwefic/scm_solthm) dumped by the ctessum-claude/WRF fork, branch earthsciml-instrumented, commit 1b4b556, around the call of conv_t_tendf_to_moist (dyn_em/module_big_step_utilities_em.F:6674-6707) in dyn_em/module_first_rk_step_part2.F (`theta_m_conv` hook, column its). Regime: step 1 (19:00 UTC, afternoon; the first physics step). Inputs are the step's theta_m = t_1 + t0, moist_old(P_qv) (equal to moist(P_qv) at this point in every dumped step), and the physics tendencies t_tendf and moist_tend(P_qv) as update_phy_ten left them; the expected value is t_tendf after the call. All tendencies are decoupled by the column mass c1h mut + c2h (c1h = 1, c2h = 0 under hybrid_opt = 0). The Fortran loop runs k = kts..kte-1 with k_end = kde = 60, so all 59 layers are converted. A float64 replay of the dumped inputs reproduces the dumped output to at most 7e-11 K/s (relative 1.5e-7) in every dumped step, while the conversion itself changes the tendency by up to 5.8e-4 K/s (almost all of it the vapour term). Single-precision reference: the whole profile is bounded at abs 1e-9 K/s (Linf) and the three layers of largest tendency are checked at rel 1e-5.
